verdict.rationale: PostHog ships an in-product AI analyst (PostHog AI) that queries data, builds insights/SQL, and explains findings, plus adjacent AI-generated insight features like Replay Vision and self-driving reports, all documented in depth. However, a hands-on community report describes the LLM feature failing a basic request (couldn't create a SQL-based cohort) and causing severe UI slowdowns, directly contradicting the polish implied by the docs. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that the AI insights actually work reliably in typical use, and resolution of the reported failure/performance bug.
